user.title: HEIKO W600
user.description: Set up a W600 listener, upstream proxy, and catalog-backed controls including service settings. Writes require an active W600 connection and fresh CMD02 readback. Default host and ports are reference values; setup does not test either endpoint. Manufacturer forwarding defaults to enabled for compatibility; choose deliberately. Service and protection parameters require qualified knowledge.
